rationale_one_line: OpenHuman's value is structural (the subconscious loop + memory tree), so the diagram-led SCHEMATIC framework carries it; geominimal's bold color blocks read as confident builder-tier infra, the opposite of cozy lab-bench, which fits Steven's deep-tech-engineer voice.
writing_tone_notes: Bold declarative. No mascot cuteness. Honor the architecture. Contractions where natural. Lead with the loop, land on ownership.
do_rules: Diagram beat is the visual hero. Show the loop, not the mascot.
Use 'memory tree' and 'subconscious loop' as named primitives.
Close on ownership, not on stars or downloads.
dont_rules: No version number in any copy surface.
No mascot, no Google Meets gimmick in the scenes. That's for the dossier and the why-this-one only.
No phrase overlap between tweet, why-this-one, and scene copy.
No claim that OpenHuman is the first or the only of anything.
